name: pyramid-site
description: An animated pixel-art pyramid construction site in a side pane: the harness conductor cracks the whip, workers carry bricks, every report adds one.

harnessPath.title: harness path
harnessPath.description: Absolute path to the harness executable. Leave empty to run `harness` from PATH.

pixelMode.title: pixel mode
pixelMode.description: half draws two pixels per cell with ▀; space draws coloured spaces, for terminals that show block glyphs double width.
